evidence_slice: HM Revenue & Customs' official Maps of Freeport East tax sites page lists Gateway 14 as one of the Freeport East tax-site map documents. The page states that the Freeport East tax sites are designated and recognised in law as geographical areas where businesses can benefit from tax reliefs to bring investment, trade and jobs to regenerate regions, and that the designations took effect on 30 December 2021.

field_evidence.development_rationale: tax reliefs intended to bring investment, trade and jobs to regenerate regions

binding_method: central-government statutory Freeport tax-site map identifier; official map boundary extraction and canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: The official HMRC collection page was accessed through public web transport; raw Gateway 14 map PDF bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
